title: ‘The Testaments’ Is Gilead’s Next Chapter: Creator and Stars Unpack Book Changes and That ‘Handmaid’s Tale’ Surprise
summary: On the set of the latest Hulu and MGM adaptation of Margaret Atwood's novel, Bruce Miller, stars Chase Infiniti, Lucy Halliday, Ann Dowd and more exclusively spoke to The Hollywood Reporter about launching another TV revolution — and how 'The Handmaid's Tale' factors into the sequel.
